newborn.definition: A baby from birth to four weeks.

baby.definition: A very young child who cannot yet walk well.

infant.definition: A very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk.

toddler.definition: A young child who is learning to walk and speak.

preschooler.definition: A child who attends a preschool or kindergarten.

child.definition: A young person who has not become an adult.

kid.definition: A young person of either sex.

youngster.definition: A young person of either sex.

childhood.definition: The time of person's life when they are a child.

growth.definition: A progression from simpler to more complex forms.

teenager.definition: A young person between childhood and adulthood.

puberty.definition: The time of life when sex glands become functional.

growth-spurt.definition: A brief phase of unusually rapid physical growth during puberty, often marked by increased height and shifting body proportions.

young-adult.definition: Young adult refers to people in their early twenties.

coming-of-age.definition: Coming of age is a stage in a person's life where they start to take on responsibilities.

juvenile.definition: Of or relating to or characteristic of or appropriate for children or young people.

minor.definition: (of a scale or mode) having half steps between the second and third degrees, and (usually) the fifth and sixth degrees, and the seventh and eighth degrees.

grown-up.definition: A grown person, rather than a child, viewed as mature, responsible, or legally an adult.

middle-aged.definition: Describing the stage of adulthood that falls roughly between the ages of forty and sixty-five.

independent.definition: Free from external control and constraint.

responsible.definition: Worthy of or requiring responsibility or trust.

professional.definition: Engaged in a profession or engaging in as a profession or means of livelihood.

retiree.definition: A person who has retired from active working.

grandparent.definition: A parent of your father or mother.

aging.definition: The organic process of growing older and showing the effects of increasing age.
aging.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Aging" in an educational description.

wisdom.definition: An Apocryphal book consisting mainly of a meditation on wisdom.

retirement.definition: The state of being retired from one's business or occupation.

golden-years.definition: The later stage of life that begins when a person retires from full-time employment.

elder.definition: A person who is older than you are.

birth.definition: The time when something begins (especially life).

first-steps.definition: First steps is the first step in a person's life, often referring to the first time they start working or starting a new job.

first-words.definition: First words is the first word someone says after they start working or starting a new job.

school-start.definition: The age of school start refers to the period when children start attending primary or secondary school.

graduation.definition: The successful completion of a program of study.

first-job.definition: The first job refers to the first job position a person gets after graduating from school.

marriage.definition: Two people who are married to each other.

parenthood.definition: The state of being a parent.

legacy.definition: (law) a gift of personal property by will.
